note: Triennial election of the Strabane rural district councillors, 1939. Nominations were received by Mr. James L. Rankin, returning officer, from 10 to 18 April 1939. Every division was settled at the nominations: the only double nomination, Loughash, ended when the retiring member John Conway withdrew on 25 April, and 'There will be no contests in connection with Strabane Rural Council elections' (Derry Journal, 26 April 1939, p. 3). No nomination was received for Glenmoran, whose retiring member, Thomas Christy, was deemed re-elected (see the division's note). No poll was held; the Tyrone polling day for 1939 is not confirmed by any page read and the folder date is provisional. Returned unopposed.
